}

    "closed-won",

}

    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Source file not found: {source_path}")

    if not reader.fieldnames:

    ]

with report_path.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as report:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(report, fieldnames=reader.fieldnames)

    writer.writerows(won_deals)

import pandas as pd

input_path = "data/sales_q3.csv"
output_path = "data/won_deals_q3.csv"
won_deal_ids = {"D001", "D003", "D006", "D009"}

df = pd.read_csv(input_path, dtype=str, keep_default_na=False)

# Find the deal-ID column case-insensitively.
candidate_names = {
    "deal id",
    "deal_id",
    "dealid",
    "id",
}
deal_id_column = next(
    (
        column
        for column in df.columns
        if column.strip().lower() in candidate_names
    ),
    None,
)

if deal_id_column is None:
    raise ValueError(
        "Could not identify the deal-ID column. "
        f"Available columns: {list(df.columns)}"
    )

normalized_ids = df[deal_id_column].str.strip().str.upper()
won_deals = df[normalized_ids.isin(won_deal_ids)].copy()

found_ids = set(normalized_ids[normalized_ids.isin(won_deal_ids)])
missing_ids = won_deal_ids - found_ids

if missing_ids:
    raise ValueError(
        "These expected won-deal IDs were not found: "
        + ", ".join(sorted(missing_ids))
    )

won_deals.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

print(f"Won deals: {len(won_deals)}")
print(f"Created: {output_path}")
